# Vitte bootstrap CLI

This reference, `vitte --help`, and scripts produced by
`vitte completion` use the same declarative command table.

## Commands

| Command | Input | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `compile` (default) | `.vit` file | Analyze and compile a source file |
| `check` | `.vit` file | Validate UTF-8, syntax and semantics |
| `run` | `.vit` file | Compile and run a program |
| `lex` | `.vit` file | Tokenize a source file |
| `parse` | `.vit` file | Parse a source file |
| `explain` | public code (for example, `E0501`) | Explain a public diagnostic code |
| `completion` | `bash`, `zsh`, or `fish` | Generate shell completion scripts |
| `help` | none | Display compiler help |
| `version` | none | Display compiler version |

The `--` separator forwards the remaining arguments to the `run` program.

## Options

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-h`, `--help` | Display help |
| `-V`, `--version` | Display compiler version |
| `-q`, `--quiet` | Suppress non-error output |
| `-v`, `--verbose` | Enable verbose output |
| `--color` | Force colored diagnostics |
| `--no-color` | Disable colored diagnostics |
| `--diagnostic=FMT`, `--diagnostic-format=FMT` | Diagnostic format: terminal, json, sarif or lsp |
| `--profile=PROFILE` | Build profile: default, debug, release, size, sanitize or freestanding |
| `--backend=BACKEND` | Code-generation backend: default, c17, native or bytecode |
| `--optimization=LEVEL`, `--opt=LEVEL` | Optimization level |
| `--target=TARGET` | Target triple or platform |
| `--jobs=N` | Maximum parallel jobs |
| `--max-errors=N` | Maximum diagnostics |
| `--max-output-bytes=N` | Maximum diagnostic/output bytes |
| `--warnings-as-errors` | Treat warnings as errors |
| `--emit-debug-info` | Emit debug information |
| `--emit-source-map` | Emit source maps |
| `--no-emit-source-map` | Disable source maps |
| `--emit-comments` | Keep generated comments |
| `--runtime-checks` | Enable runtime checks |
| `--no-runtime-checks` | Disable runtime checks |
| `--bounds-checks` | Enable bounds checks |
| `--no-bounds-checks` | Disable bounds checks |
| `--null-checks` | Enable null checks |
| `--no-null-checks` | Disable null checks |
| `--overflow-checks` | Enable overflow checks |
| `--no-overflow-checks` | Disable overflow checks |
| `--deterministic` | Enable deterministic builds |
| `--no-deterministic` | Disable deterministic builds |
| `--incremental` | Enable incremental compilation |
| `--no-incremental` | Disable incremental compilation |
| `--offline` | Disable network access |
| `--locked` | Require locked dependencies |
| `--frozen-dependencies` | Require frozen dependencies |
| `--force` | Force the requested operation |
| `--manifest-path=PATH` | Use a manifest at PATH |
| `--project-root=PATH` | Set project root |
| `--build-dir=PATH` | Set build directory |
| `--cache-dir=PATH` | Set cache directory |
| `--sysroot=PATH` | Set sysroot |
| `--registry=URL` | Set package registry |
| `--timings` | Display compiler phase timings |
| `--emit-tokens` | Print lexer tokens |
| `--emit-ast` | Print an AST summary |
| `--emit-hir` | Print the lowered HIR |
| `--emit-ir` | Print the lowered IR |
| `--emit-c` | Emit generated C17 |
| `-c`, `--emit-object` | Compile to a relocatable object |
| `--stop-after-lexer` | Stop after lexing |
| `--stop-after-parser` | Stop after parsing |
| `--stop-after-sema` | Stop after semantic analysis |
| `--validate-utf8` | Validate source UTF-8 |
| `--no-validate-utf8` | Skip source UTF-8 validation |
| `--debug-info`, `--debug` | Emit debug information |
| `--debug-probes` | Enable compiler probe runtime |
| `--line-directives` | Emit #line directives in generated C |
| `-o PATH`, `--output PATH`, `--output=PATH` | Write compiler output to PATH |
| `-- ARGS` | Forward remaining arguments to `run` |

The `--stop-after-*` options are mutually exclusive. `run` cannot be
combined with intermediate output or a pipeline stop. The pairs
`--quiet`/`--verbose`, `--color`/`--no-color`, and
`--validate-utf8`/`--no-validate-utf8` are also mutually exclusive.
The CLI validates these conflicts before starting the driver.

## Configuration and precedence

Configuration values are merged in this order, from lowest to highest precedence:

```text
defaults < vitte.toml/.vitte/config < environment < command line
```
`VITTE_CONFIG_FILE` selects an explicit configuration file. Environment
variables use uppercase `VITTE_<KEY>` names, with hyphens replaced by
underscores (for example, `VITTE_MAX_ERRORS` and
`VITTE_DIAGNOSTIC_FORMAT`). CLI values take precedence over earlier
sources. Configuration is merged and validated once before the pipeline.
`VITTE_MODULE_PATH` adds module search roots separated by the host path-list
separator (`:` on Unix and `;` on Windows).

## Diagnostics

The `terminal`, `json`, `sarif`, and `lsp` formats share public codes,
phases, severities, type contexts, help, causes, and source locations.
JSON and SARIF retain source byte offsets. LSP adds a UTF-16 range and
keeps raw offsets in `data`.

`vitte explain CODE` accepts public codes in the registry
(`Edddd`, `Wdddd`, `Ndddd`, and `Hdddd`). Add `--diagnostic=json`
to print the structured explanation.

## Shell completion

```sh
vitte completion bash > vitte.bash
vitte completion zsh > _vitte
vitte completion fish > ~/.config/fish/completions/vitte.fish
```
The three scripts are generated at runtime from the same table as the
help text. Short and long aliases (such as `-h`/`--help` and
`-o`/`--output`) are included automatically.
